basis: September Publishing remediation is a manual trace for replacement, not the new operating procedure.

correctedSeptemberExecutionTruth.sintraSoshie: Superseded execution objects removed during remediation; not the authoritative final scheduler for the completed September run
correctedSeptemberExecutionTruth.replacementTarget: Replace browser-operated Meta and LinkedIn steps with JM1-owned platform adapters; do not give Sintra replacement credit for final September execution.

founderCorrectionsPreserved: The Shift was released last month relative to the September 2026 campaign; classify as new/recent, not backlist and not draft.
All new images must include the official J Merrill logo asset.
Meta post details may be Facebook-specific or Instagram-specific within the same Meta scheduling surface.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: September required human judgment to choose Sean A Crowley I, The Shift, Strategies for Success, publishing inquiries, and brand education lanes.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Promote only source-backed titles/authors and approved Publishing programs.
manualOperations.futureSystemComponent: Campaign Authority Engine + Portfolio Marketing Health

manualOperations.whyNecessary: The live month needed daily platform timing and launch-runway ordering.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Protect launch dates and avoid overloading one author/title lane.
manualOperations.futureSystemComponent: Lifecycle Trigger Registry + Execution Schedule Validation

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Rejected creative had to be replaced with real source-backed book covers.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Use actual cover only; do not AI-edit or approximate book covers.
failureModesObserved: source assets assumed missing too early

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Author creative required governed portraits or a rights-safe fallback.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Use governed author imagery only; otherwise hold likeness-specific creative.
manualOperations.output: Author asset status and fallback path.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Every new image must include the correct J Merrill logo, not a fake mark or placeholder.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Use official approved logo asset only.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Copy needed correction when a title was treated as draft/backlist instead of newly released.
manualOperations.decisionRule: New/recent releases cannot be classified as backlist or draft.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Meta uploads exposed RGB/export constraints and exact-file handling issues.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Normalize only technical format; preserve approved visual content exactly.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Manual rebuild produced higher-quality People-First/Why-First creative after rejecting registry-card output.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Create public art that supports the reason to care, not internal process labels.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: The operator manually blocked bad, malformed, or off-brand outputs.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Reject if fake asset, malformed layout, missing logo, poor public quality, or wrong framing.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Founder corrections changed The Shift status and current marketing language.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Authoritative Founder correction supersedes stale generated classification.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Meta allows Facebook and Instagram details inside the same flow, but captions may differ by platform.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Use channel-appropriate copy without changing facts or CTA authority.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: September replacement had to shift from calendar filler to audience-centered public posts.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Public post must make the person/audience reason clear.
failureModesObserved: automation filled a calendar but weakened judgment

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Each post needed a clear reason to exist beyond posting cadence.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Publish only when the post explains why this matters now.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Internal governance terms and rights metadata had to stay backstage.
manualOperations.decisionRule: No internal governance vocabulary in public copy.
failureModesObserved: public exposure of internal governance language

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Wrong workspace/page context was a live risk across Sintra, Meta, and LinkedIn.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Use immutable destination IDs where available; never infer from similar names.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Facebook had to be rebuilt through Meta Business Suite UI with exact creative.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Schedule only after exact file, destination, story state, and time preflight pass.
manualOperations.futureSystemComponent: MetaAdapter automation requirement: Facebook Page publishing/media upload/readback

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Instagram had to be rebuilt through Meta Business Suite UI with exact creative and separate platform proof.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Planner presence alone is not publication proof; require IG-specific confirmation/readback.
manualOperations.futureSystemComponent: MetaAdapter automation requirement: Instagram Graph publishing/media upload/readback

manualOperations.whyNecessary: LinkedIn native organization UI was used because owned LinkedIn API publishing was not yet proven.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Schedule to Publishing organization only and verify requested-vs-actual state before certification.
manualOperations.futureSystemComponent: LinkedInAdapter automation requirement: organization publishing/media upload/readback

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Meta defaulted Facebook Story behavior in a way that could create unintended placements.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Facebook Story must be off unless explicitly approved.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: LinkedIn accessibility metadata was manually entered.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Attach approved alt text to every LinkedIn image post.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Every platform needed evidence beyond draft presence.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Verify destination, creative, caption, date, time, and platform state.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Some days/platforms completed while others held or needed retry.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Retry only failed/held platform execution without duplicating passed records.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Old Soshie items stayed until exact-file replacements were scheduled and verified.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Never remove executable fallback before replacement is confirmed.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Soshie duplicates had to be retired once Meta/LinkedIn native replacements existed.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Delete only superseded platform item with matching date/destination/campaign.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: The rebuild needed a single authoritative scheduler per platform/date/item.
manualOperations.decisionRule: One platform item per campaign occurrence unless explicitly split.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Scheduled, published, held, and deleted states had to be classified separately.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Do not promote state without direct platform evidence.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: The September rescue depended on screenshot and JSON evidence to remain auditable.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Capture enough evidence to support every pass/hold/deleted claim.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: Operator had to choose rebuild, retry, hold, preserve, or delete on each exception.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Choose the least risky action that preserves public quality and avoids duplicate execution.

manualOperations.whyNecessary: The system must keep marketing moving after September without a new manual calendar build.
manualOperations.decisionRule: Generate only eligible next items with source-backed assets and approved campaign authority.

closureRule: Future routine Publishing execution must convert this trace into Dataverse-governed system behavior before replacing manual/browser scheduling.
